messages:
nina: heads up — found a batch of staging snapshots missing SSE-C/CMK metadata after last night's deploy. uploader logs show 503 from kms-proxy briefly. :eyes:
praveen: ugh. which deploy changed perms? we did an RBAC sweep around 22:40UTC to prune unused roles.
cory: i can pull cloudtrail—maybe the kms:GenerateDataKey call failed and uploader fell back to no-encrypt path.
encops-bot: alert ꟷ kms-proxy service reported increased 5xx from 22:38:12 to 22:42:07 (~230s) — CPU spike on proxy nodes, scaled back to 0 pods at 22:41:30.
lisa: can you paste the uploader error lines?
nina: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T22:40:01Z ERROR uploader: failed to encrypt chunk: kms-proxy 503 Service Unavailable
2026-03-20T22:40:02Z WARN uploader: falling back to unencrypted upload (sse header omitted)
```
praveen: that falling-back behavior is intentional but unsafe for staging. we should block fallbacks unless explicit env var set.
oliver: agree — quick mitigations: 1) re-enable RBAC role we pruned for uploader (uploader-serviceaccount) so it can call proxy with fallback disabled, 2) re-run a subset re-encrypt job, 3) add probe+alert on SSE headers at ingest.
nina: for audit: cory, pls correlate cloudtrail events for KMS calls between 22:36-22:43 and include IAM principal. sample command: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2026-03-20T22:36:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T22:43:00Z
```
cory: on it. initial find: uploader-service-sa attempted kms:GenerateDataKey at 22:40:01 and got 503 from proxy — cloudtrail shows the proxy IP but KMS backend returned 200. suggests proxy behaved as gateway error, not KMS perms.
praveen: so RBAC prune likely stopped the proxy from obtaining an ephemeral grant on behalf of uploader? recall we use kms-proxy to mint ephemeral grants using an internal role. if that role lost sts:AssumeRole to the proxy, proxy can't call kms with delegated identity.
lisa: check proxy's role assumePolicy changes in the same deploy window.
encops-bot: gitops: PR 5843 merged by praveen @ 22:35UTC removed 'role:keystore-observer' binding from namespace infra-uploader.
praveen: oh — that is the change. i removed keystore-observer because it looked unused. my bad.
nina: steps to remediate:
- reapply keystore-observer binding to infra-uploader namespace (hotfix)
- restart kms-proxy pods to pick up role cache refresh
- run a small re-upload job to confirm SSE headers present
- schedule sweep to re-encrypt any objects uploaded between 22:36-22:44

cory: i ran a quick head-object on one suspect object: 
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket staging-snapshots --key snaps/2026-03-20/abc123
{"Metadata": {}, "ServerSideEncryption": null}
```
praveen: yep null SSE. we need a safe re-encrypt: copy-with-server-side-encryption-aws-kms or download-encrypt-reupload. prefer server-side rewrap with CMK to avoid egress.
oliver: runbook note: for bulk rewrap use S3 CopyObject with `--server-side-encryption aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id <CMK>` and `--metadata-directive REPLACE`. test on subset first.
lisa: also add detection: Lambda that runs on PutObject to assert SSE headers present and if missing, write event to security-audit queue.
nina: for postmortem: include timeline (RBAC prune -> proxy 5xx -> fallback uploads -> detection), decision to allow fallback, and follow-up policy: no silent fallback in uploader.
praveen: i'll open hotfix PR to re-add role and add a revert to the RBAC sweep change. also will add CloudTrail quick query to surface proxy 5xx anomalies.
encops-bot: task created: ENCRYPTOPS-714 (hotfix RBAC restore) — assigned to praveen.
cory: i've exported list of affected keys (approx 47 objects) and pushed to a secure ticket. re-encrypt window captured.
oliver: after hotfix, i'll run a canary rewrap and then kick bulk copy job with rate limit to avoid load on kms-proxy.
lisa: follow-ups:
- change uploader to fail hard when kms step fails unless env var explicitly allows fallback (DEV-only)
- add proxy health endpoint probe to infra SLOs
- add audit rule for any PutObject without SSE on snapshot buckets
nina: thanks all. can we meet 09:30UTC tomorrow for postmortem sync? i want product & infra present.
praveen: yes. i'll include timeline and the RBAC diff in the meeting notes.
cory: closing loop — i also found one unrelated perms error for archival job; will open separate thread. :+1:
